planId.rationale: One bounded pilot plan; no price or checkout.

version.rationale: Nonfunctional rationale correction; all catalog limits remain unchanged.

effectiveDate.rationale: Initial policy date; activation/enrollment is a later responsibility.

capabilities.rationale: Owner-approved pilot architecture; no custom server code.

maxPages.rationale: Seven authored-page slots provide bounded headroom for a small catalog website.

system404Counts.rationale: Generated system 404 is outside the authored-page allowance.

ssl.rationale: Owner requires SSL with hosting; contract inclusion is not deployment evidence.

domain.rationale: Client brings their own domain; no domain sale.

cmsCollections.rationale: Only the three approved optional content collections.

excludes.rationale: Work stays within deterministic templates and prepared client materials.

contractVersion.rationale: Separate wire-contract version from policy semver.

maxSectionsPerPage.rationale: Bounded headroom for catalog landing sections.

maxJsonBytes.rationale: Bounds parsing and validation work before semantic traversal.

idPattern.rationale: Stable ASCII IDs; no path fragments or prototype keys.

pagePathPattern.rationale: Canonical trailing-slash routes with at most three safe segments.

reservedPaths.rationale: System error, asset and service namespaces cannot be authored pages.

paragraph.rationale: Supports detailed text without unbounded paragraphs.

richText.rationale: Allows small articles and legal content.

colorSlots.rationale: Seven semantic color roles without copying client branding.

colorPattern.rationale: Literal RGB values only; no CSS expressions.

fonts.rationale: Reference fonts plus no-download system alternatives.

externalSchemes.rationale: Explicit link protocols without script URLs or third-party embeds.

formats.rationale: Matches supplied reference raster assets; uploaded SVG excluded.

altRequired.rationale: Every image needs descriptive accessible copy.

hash.rationale: Binds each declaration to actual supplied bytes.

required.rationale: A verified owner or enabled site administrator must approve the immutable server snapshot through the browser.

digest.rationale: Hashes the entire canonical spec; the immutable browser approval separately binds revision, actor, time and exact output hash.

previewRequired.rationale: The server-produced verified snapshot and required screenshots must be reviewable before browser approval.

countsWhen.rationale: Validation, rejected work and retries are not new applied requests.

maxBlocksModified.rationale: Selected per-request block cap; additions to new pages count.

maxGlobalOperations.rationale: Shared configuration has a separate allowance.

maxOperations.rationale: Bounds processing independently of final change size.

operations.rationale: Typed bounded changes; no arbitrary patches, page deletion or renaming.

doesNotCount.rationale: Content-only CMS edits do not change the static site contract.
